quote: Then Goliath exploded out of the park: tail high, slobber shining at his jowls, bounding as if he'd been waiting to be a dragon that day.
Neighbors peered from behind curtains; the dog slowed, head cocked. He wasn't mean — his bark was big and his tongue was slobbery, but his eyes were softer than his noise.
Goliath lay on the bench by the pine tree, head on his paws and watching us with the patient expression he'd used on the bridge.
